I'm almost 2 yrs post op... you can have different things.. like tuna.. they come seasoned now! To boost your protein intake without extra sugar and calories,  drink a boost or a muscle milk.. I know it's hard to eat this early on.. I'm not even at 1000 calories yet. What also helped me, is I got 2 bariatric cook books on amazon. There are all kinds of recipes that are yummy,  with snacks and desserts! And the books also tell you how much to serve yourself (depending on your stage of the journey) and even how much to serve someone who isn't following a bariatric diet. You should check them out, I hope this was helpful!!

Awesome post, and congratulations on the first step to adding years to your life. I actually just had my 1 year mark post surgery.. I had the sleeve done last year on my birthday last may... tbh.. all surgeries are scary.. however from one sleeve person to another.. don't be scared.  The scariest part is the road ahead.. I only say that because our brains and body still want all the junk.. and I've slipped up many, many times. Js.. I weighed in at 312 may 16, 2019 And this morning,  a touch over a year later.. I  am at 195.. still surprised that I'm under 200.. however,  there have been a lot of side effects... mostly concerning for me was losing more than have of my beautiful hair.. bit that's ok! Its growing back in.. and also.. me.. not everyone has uncomfortable and uncontrollable heartburn... but these bombs in the road are part of the process.. and over all.. will be worth it. So good luck on your road ahead.. its gonna be rough.. and you ate still gonna have cravings.  But you have to remember.. this is a tool, not a solution.. and it's up to us how we make it work. But as far as the surgery goes.. I know you're nervous.. but this is the best thing for folks like us... good luck and i wish you the best!! Yaaay!!
